lines.speaker: arkus
lines.text: The forge frame goes where you marked it. Wood and hardwood — I will make it a forge.

lines.speaker: arkus
lines.text: And a sickbed. The outpost has none. Build both before the forest sends the next one of us back broken.

lines.speaker: arkus
lines.text: The forge holds heat now. Bring me metal. I will make you something that does not break when you need it to hold. I do not make junk.

lines.speaker: arkus
lines.text: Say what you mean. It is faster.
